To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
3-oxa-1-alkyl-2-aryloxy-3-oxatetanols are excellent electrophiles for the synthesis of diastereomerally pure 1,2-disubstituted diols in high yields.
the nucleophilic ring opening of 2-phenyloxetanes 2 with various nucleophiles in the presence of BF 3 affords 1,2-diol derivatives 6-11 and 21-23 in diastereoselective manner.
3-alkyl-2-aryl-3-oxatetrahydrofurans (3-oxetans) are excellent substrates for the preparation of 1,2- and 1,3-diols by nucleophilic displacement reactions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of nucleophiles suitable for the nucleophilic ring opening of 1,3-oxetanes
the identification of suitable nucleophiles and the elucidation of possible side reactions.
the development of a general method for the preparation of 1,2-diol systems in diastereomeric purity by the ring opening of 2,3-unsymmetrically substituted 3-oxa-1-oxacycloalkanes with nucleophiles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ring opening of 4-substituted-2,2-dialkoxyoxetanes by nucleophiles is a powerful tool for the synthesis of 1,2-difunctional compounds in diastereoisomerically pure form, provided that the 3-oxotetanols are used as substrates.
nucleophilic displacement reactions of 3-alkyl-2-aryl-3-oxatetanols are suitable reactions to access the corresponding 1-aryl-2,3-diols.
3-oxatetrahydrofurans can indeed serve as electrophiles for nucleophilic ring opening reactions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ring opening of 1a with alkyl-, aryl- and thio nucleophiles is possible, whereas reactions of amides and alcohols are less favourable.
the ring opening of 2,3-disubstituted 3-oxa-2,4-dioxacyclopentanes by nucleophiles is a powerful method for the synthesis of 1,2-diol compounds.
3-oxa-1-alkanols are suitable electrophiles for the nucleophilic opening of their oxetane ring.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ring opening reaction of 3-alkoxyoxetanols by carbon nucleophiles can be used as a method for the synthesis of 1,2-diol compounds in high yield and diastereomer purity.
3-oxatetrahydrofurans can be opened with various nucleophiles to yield diastereomerical pure 1,2- diols, which are important building blocks for the synthesis of complex natural products.
the use of a Lewis acid is essential to achieve a selective ring opening reaction at C-4 of 3-alkyl-2-aryl-3-oxatans.
